children: Eurozone annual inflation accelerated to 3.2% in August 2026 from 2.8% in July, matching May’s two-and-a-half-year high but coming slightly below the preliminary estimate of 3.3%.
The increase was driven largely by energy prices, with energy inflation jumping to 14.3%, its highest level since January 2023.
Services inflation eased to 3.0%, its lowest level in four months, while core inflation, excluding energy and food, edged down to 2.4% from 2.5%.
Among the region’s largest economies, inflation rose to 2.9% in Germany from 2.8%, 2.6% in France from 2.4%, 4.6% in Spain from 3.9% and 3.2% in Italy from 2.9%.

title: Eurozone inflation rises to 3.2% in August
